patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality lifestyle imagery and video are used as primary section dividers and content showcases, creating a visually rich experience.
Product listings utilize a consistent four-column grid with minimal information per item, focusing on the product image.
A sophisticated serif font is paired with a clean sans-serif, with serif used for prominent titles and sans-serif for body text and functional elements.
A muted, sophisticated palette of dark greys, whites, and subtle off-whites is accented by a deep burgundy for calls to action and interactive elements.

The hero video blurs and darkens as the user scrolls, while subsequent content sections scroll up over it, creating a subtle depth effect, and a location selection popup remains sticky in the top right.
Key content sections are introduced with large, full-bleed images that act as visual anchors, often with minimal text overlays.

technique_notes: The hero section features a background video that plays continuously. As the user scrolls, the video element applies a blur and a darkening overlay, while the subsequent content sections scroll up and cover it, creating a layered reveal effect. A persistent, fixed-position overlay for location selection remains visible in the top right corner across pages and scroll depths.
Product listings are presented in a responsive grid, where each item displays a product image, title, and a 'NEW ARRIVALS' tag, maintaining consistent spacing and alignment.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings use an elegant serif font, moderately larger (~2-3x body) than the clean sans-serif body text, with generous letter-spacing for a refined feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, full-bleed, high-quality photography and video as primary content elements, rather than just decorative backgrounds, creates a highly immersive and luxurious visual narrative. This visual-first approach, combined with understated typography, elevates the brand's perceived value and heritage.
